name: Silt Horror's Grasp
description:
You invoke the power of Silt, causing grasping tendrils of powdery silt to erupt from yourself. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
summary: You invoke the power of Silt, causing grasping tendrils of powdery silt to erupt from yourself. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Strength saving throw against Necrotic damage.
notes: Dark Sun homebrew spell. Rework of Arms of Hadar for the Silt patron domain.
